MAHABANK Q2 FY27: net profit Rs 2,310 cr (+41.4% YoY), NII Rs 3,954 cr (+21.8%), gross NPA 1.25%, net NPA 0.12%, domestic NIM 3.97%, advances +29.6%.
ITC Hotels up ~8% on Q2 PAT +51% to Rs 201 cr (Business Standard).
Ather Energy closed up ~18% on Q2 turnaround (Business Standard).

PDF https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/oct-2026/1792079571420.pdf ; NSE circular NSE/CMTR/76963 (16 Oct 2026) https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR76963.zip .
